speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pyelonephritis secondary to acute bacterial infection (E. coli).

Since your urinalysis confirmed E. coli and the ultrasound showed hydronephrosis, this suggests an obstruction caused the infection to ascend despite your prior treatment. Given the normal post-void residual, we should consider a structural anomaly like a kidney stone or stricture. Have you noticed any sharp, colicky pain moving from your flank to your groin, or any nausea/vomiting?
